parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The type of the cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: DiskName
parameters.description: The name of the cloud disk.

parameters.name: Encrypted
parameters.description: Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceBillingCycle
parameters.description: The billing cycle of the instance. Valid values: Hour, Day, Month.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Currently, only **PostPaid** (pay-as-you-go) is supported.

parameters.name: KMSKeyId
parameters.description: The ID of the KMS key used by the cloud disk.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the cloud disk. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: SnapshotId
parameters.description: The snapshot used to create the cloud disk.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can add up to 20 tags in a single call.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the topic. **Key** and **Value** must be specified or left empty at the same time. If both are specified, topics are filtered by the tag. If neither is specified, all topics are queried.
